scope: Initial reviewed terrain and resource block batch; not full block coverage.

topics.mining: A pickaxe drops cobblestone from stone. Use a Silk Touch pickaxe to collect stone itself. Fortune does not increase its drop.
topics.location: Stone is widespread underground in the Overworld, especially above Y=0. It transitions into deepslate toward the bottom. You can also smelt cobblestone into stone.

topics.mining: Use any pickaxe to collect cobblestone. Without a pickaxe it drops nothing. Silk Touch is unnecessary, and Fortune does not increase its drop.
topics.location: Mine ordinary stone with a pickaxe to get cobblestone. It also occurs in structures such as villages, monster rooms and strongholds.

topics.mining: Use a diamond or netherite pickaxe to collect obsidian. Other tools drop nothing. Silk Touch is unnecessary, and Fortune does not increase its drop.
topics.location: Pour water over lava source blocks to make obsidian. Flowing lava produces other blocks instead. You can also find obsidian in ruined portals and the End.

topics.mining: Glass drops nothing unless broken with a Silk Touch tool. Fortune does not help recover it.
topics.location: Smelt sand or red sand to make glass. Some structures also contain glass, but you need Silk Touch to recover those blocks.

topics.mining: Sand drops itself; a shovel is fastest. Silk Touch is unnecessary and Fortune does not increase the drop. Unsupported sand falls and can suffocate you.
topics.location: Look in deserts, beaches and shallow water for sand. Red sand is a different block found in badlands.

topics.mining: A shovel is fastest for gravel. Normally it has a 10% chance to drop flint instead of gravel. Fortune I raises this to about 14%, Fortune II to 25%, and Fortune III to 100%. Silk Touch collects gravel instead of flint.
topics.location: Look in rivers, oceans, underground gravel patches and windswept gravelly hills. Gravel also occurs in the Nether.

topics.mining: Breaking clay normally drops 4 clay balls. A shovel is fastest. Silk Touch collects the clay block instead; Fortune does not increase the clay-ball count.
topics.location: Look underwater in shallow rivers and lakes, or on the floors of lush-cave ponds. You can also craft a clay block from 4 clay balls.

topics.mining: Use a Silk Touch tool to collect ice; a pickaxe is fastest. Without Silk Touch it drops no item and can leave water when a supporting block is underneath.
topics.location: Look for frozen surface water in cold biomes such as frozen rivers and frozen oceans.

topics.mining: Use a Silk Touch tool to collect packed ice; a pickaxe is fastest. Without Silk Touch it drops nothing and does not turn into water.
topics.location: Find packed ice in ice spikes, frozen peaks and frozen-ocean icebergs, or craft it from 9 ice blocks.

topics.mining: Use a Silk Touch tool to collect blue ice; a pickaxe is fastest. Without Silk Touch it drops nothing.
topics.location: Find blue ice in frozen-ocean icebergs, especially their lower portions, or craft it from 9 packed ice blocks.

topics.mining: Use a shovel to collect 4 snowballs from a snow block. A Silk Touch shovel collects the block itself. Other ordinary tools do not collect snowballs.
topics.location: Find snow blocks in snowy mountains, ice spikes and igloos, or craft them from 4 snowballs.

topics.mining: A bookshelf normally drops 3 books; an axe is fastest. Silk Touch collects the bookshelf itself. Fortune does not add more books.
topics.location: Find bookshelves in stronghold libraries, village libraries and some woodland-mansion rooms, or craft them from books and wooden planks.

topics.mining: Use a Silk Touch pickaxe to collect an ender chest. A pickaxe without Silk Touch drops 8 obsidian, without returning the eye of ender. Stored items remain in your personal ender-chest inventory.
topics.location: Find ender chests in some End-city treasure rooms, or craft one from 8 obsidian and 1 eye of ender.

topics.mining: Budding amethyst drops nothing, even with Silk Touch. Leave it in place if you want it to keep growing amethyst buds. It cannot be collected normally in Survival.
topics.location: Find budding amethyst in the inner layer of amethyst geodes underground in the Overworld. You cannot craft it or collect it normally in Survival.

topics.mining: Use a diamond or netherite pickaxe to collect ancient debris. Other tools drop nothing. It drops itself without Silk Touch; Fortune does not multiply it.
topics.location: Look underground in the Nether; around Y=16 is a useful search level. Ancient debris is rare and normally buried rather than exposed to air. Smelt it into netherite scrap.
